slides.heading: WHAT ACTUALLY CHANGED FOR YOUR KITAP
slides.body: Two regulations updated the rules in 2023–2024. Your existing KITAP — issued under the old regime — remains fully valid until its natural expiry. But at your next renewal, three things work differently. Here is what you need to know before that date arrives.

carved_facts.label: STATUS
carved_facts.value: Existing KITAP: fully valid, no mandatory conversion

carved_facts.label: SCOPE
carved_facts.value: 3 changes affect your next renewal — not your current card

slides.heading: THE REFORM PACKAGE: FOUR INSTRUMENTS, ONE IMPACT
slides.body: The reform is not a single regulation. It is a layered package. Understanding which instrument governs which rule is the difference between acting correctly and acting on outdated advice from your previous agent.

carved_facts.label: PERMENKUMHAM 22/2023
carved_facts.value: Base reform: visa and izin tinggal tetap (permanent stay permit) system overhaul

carved_facts.label: PERMENKUMHAM 11/2024
carved_facts.value: Amendment: Golden Visa adjustments + updated penjamin definitions

carved_facts.label: UU NO. 63/2024
carved_facts.value: National immigration law: abolished MERP as a separate document

slides._post_critic_fix: 2026-05-22 critic FAIL retry: heading THREE→FOUR INSTRUMENTS to honor Article 6.3.1 bullet promise (body has 4 carved_facts)

slides.heading: MERP IS NOW AUTOMATIC AND FREE
slides.body: UU No. 63/2024 abolished the MERP as a standalone document. Multiple exit re-entry rights are now automatically integrated into your KITAP at issuance — no separate procedure, no extra government fee. Existing MERP documents stay valid until their printed expiry date.

list_items.label: RULE
list_items.value: Lapor (mandatory check-in) every 5 years — unlimited-duration KITAP holders

list_items.label: COST
list_items.value: IDR 0 — no PNBP government fee for the Lapor check-in

list_items.label: SCOPE
list_items.value: After first renewal — KITAP becomes jangka waktu tidak terbatas (unlimited)

list_items.label: ACTION
list_items.value: Mark your calendar: 5 years from your last Lapor date — no earlier, no later

slides.heading: RENEWAL WINDOW: RULES YOU CANNOT MISS

list_items.label: WINDOW OPENS
list_items.value: Submit perpanjangan (renewal) earliest 3 months before expiry — Pasal 128 Ayat 3

list_items.label: HARD DEADLINE
list_items.value: File no later than expiry date — post-expiry is a separate procedure

list_items.label: OVERSTAY SHIELD
list_items.value: Filed AND PNBP paid before expiry? You are NOT in overstay — Pasal 128 Ayat 4

list_items.label: FEE
list_items.value: KITAP-RET PNBP: IDR 45,000,000 — pay before expiry to activate overstay

slides.heading: NEW PASSPORT: ONE MORE VISIT TO IMIGRASI
slides.subheading: KITAP UPDATE IS MANDATORY — SEPARATE FROM MERP
slides.body: If you renew your passport, you must update your KITAP with the new passport number at your local Kantor Imigrasi (local immigration office). This requirement is independent of MERP, unaffected by the 2023–2024 reform, and fully in force. One visit. Bring both documents.

slides.heading: PENJAMIN AT RENEWAL: WHO FILES FOR YOU
slides.subheading: INDEPENDENT RESIDENT — NOT AN INDEPENDENT APPLICANT

list_items.label: DAILY RESIDENCY
list_items.value: KITAP holders: no sponsor obligation for ongoing stay — unlike KITAS

list_items.label: AT RENEWAL
list_items.value: A penjamin (guarantor) must formally submit the renewal — Permenimipas 5/2025

list_items.label: WHO QUALIFIES
list_items.value: Licensed immigration agent, notarized individual, or registered employer

list_items.label: ACTION
list_items.value: Confirm your penjamin is Permenimipas 5/2025 compliant before month -3

slides.heading: YOUR KITAP PROTECTS YOU. THE RENEWAL WINDOW DOES NOT WAIT.
